subject: maths
question:
The line graph shows the Production (in crores) of three companies over years. Find the year in which total production in company Z is 30 percent more than that of company X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1fdb36705dc17157c1b090d4290300f7cea93f71218f8e3bf4fc31199533cea.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

Production in company Z is more to that of company X only in 2018 and 2020.

Percentage of production in company Z to that of company X in 2018 = 65/45 × 100 = 144.44

⇒ 44.44 % more

Percentage of production in company Z to that of company X in 2020 = 65/50 × 100 = 130

⇒ 30 % more

**Total production in company Z is 30 percent more than that of company X in year 2020.**
